decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions, by reason of their size, position and appearance, would fail to be subordinate to the proportions and footprint of the original building, would be out of character with the appearance of the original property, and detrimental to the street scene, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed extensions, by reason of their bulk, position and excessive depth along the western boundary, would represent an overbearing and un-neighbourly overdevelopment of the site, which would result in unacceptable enclosure, loss of light and loss of outlook to the ground floor flank habitable-room windows of the neighbouring flats, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed off-street parking arrangements, due to the reduction of existing parking provision, increase in the number of residential units on the site, and insufficient number of parking spaces proposed, would fail to meet the Council's parking standards. The proposal is therefore likely to result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a three-storey side extension, single-storey rear extension and alterations to the existing flats to create a total of four two-bedroom flats.
